spec.text: Image 1 is the couple in their registration-day outfits (he: black rectangular glasses, black relaxed suit over a white crewneck, black shoes; she: half-up wavy brown hair, blush pink cardigan, ivory calf-length dress, ivory Mary Jane shoes, small blush and cream bouquet). Images 2 and 3 are the woman's and the man's FACE reference sheets: copy their faces exactly (large round dark-brown eyes with white catchlights, small button noses, round blushing cheeks). Image 4 is their marriage certificate design. Image 5 is Four Four South Village already drawn in the approved style: use the SAME long two-story grey house with the upstairs balcony and the green, blue and red doors, and the same blue-green Taipei 101 behind it. Image 6 shows the approved warm daylight color palette and image 7 the approved art style. Scene: a gentle sunny afternoon back at Four Four South Village, soft warm light, a pale soft-blue sky with a few soft white clouds, colors muted and warm exactly like images 5, 6 and 7 - NOT a saturated electric-blue sky. Medium shot from the knees up, faces large and clear: the couple stand side by side in front of the house and hold their marriage certificate up together with their inner hands, its FRONT facing the camera; she holds her bouquet in her other hand. Both smile warmly at the camera with their eyes OPEN. The certificate is a simplified version of image 4: top half a blue illustrated night sky with tiny fireworks, a little city skyline and a tiny waving cartoon couple; bottom half white with a few faint lines; no readable words, names or numbers. Sculpted matte clay figurines, never flat 2D. No other people, no readable text, no photorealism.
